acceptanceCriteria: The operator guide describes the implemented transports, their flags and their remaining limits (including `affected`), and the line-citations gate passes.
body:
Filed from the audit of https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/64 (generic ExternalEvidenceProvider contract) on 2026-09-22.

`docs/EXTERNAL-EVIDENCE-PROVIDERS.md:174-183` lists MCP and remote providers under `Not yet supported`, while `docs/specs/README.md` marks the transports, MCP and remote specs as implemented and `impact` takes `--provider-command`/`--provider-mcp`. The operator guide contradicts the delivered contract.

completion.reason: Premise corrected: --provider-mcp was never shipped and the guide's MCP/remote bullet matches EEP-TR-009/010. The stale bullets were the ETS-V1 items (one-hop widening, no checkout inspection); replaced with the walk bounds and checkout dirty-path rule, plus the affected command-transport sentence and an ETS-V1 paragraph.

title: docs: EXTERNAL-EVIDENCE-PROVIDERS.md still says MCP and remote transports are not supported
